response.answer:
Here are the key points about the Extension Hose for the AIS Clear Cold Therapy Unit from PMT:

• **Product purpose** – It is an add-on hose that extends the reach between your AIS Clear (Arctic Ice Clear) cold therapy machine and your therapy pad, giving you more flexibility in positioning the cooler while you use the pad.

• **Compatibility** – The extension hose is designed to be compatible with:
  - Coolman
  - Leonns
  - Arctic Ice Clear (AIS Clear)
  - Oasis Space

• **Length** – The hose is **5 feet** long, providing additional distance from the machine to the pad for more comfortable setup around beds, chairs, or recliners.

• **Couplings** – It includes **leak‑proof couplings**, designed to connect securely to the AIS Clear system and pad tubing to help prevent water leakage during use.

• **Product codes / variants**:
  - Standard Extension Hose for AIS Clear Cold Therapy Unit – **Product Code: CTU2CHOSE**
  - Extension Hose for AIS Clear Cold Therapy Unit for back pad – **Product Code: CTU2CHOSEEXT**

• **Use with pads** – It is intended for use with AIS Clear / Arctic Ice Clear cold therapy systems and their pads (such as the universal pad or back pad). It is part of a **water-based cold therapy system**, not an electrical TENS lead or wire.

For purchasing, detailed specs, or to match the exact hose to your AIS Clear setup, you can visit: https://paintechnology.com or the product/category pages, or contact customer service at info@paintechnology.com or 1-800-239-7880.

response.answer:
For Mobicushion and Mobicushion‑L, PMT’s warranty policy distinguishes between the main device and its accessories (which include the battery):

• Mobi Cushions (including Mobicushion‑L) carry a 6‑month warranty on the unit itself.
• Accessories supplied with the device — for example, lead wires, battery, and carrying case — are **not covered** under the warranty.
• The warranty is for replacement of like items only, and outdated technology is not covered if the item is no longer available on the common market as a new product.
• Shipping is excluded from warranty coverage and will be assessed on any replacement.
• Consumable or hygienic items are not covered under warranty.
• Pictures and details of defects need to be provided for warranty consideration.

So specifically for the Mobicushion‑L **battery**, PMT’s policy is that it is an accessory and is **not covered** under the device warranty. For options on replacement batteries or service, you would need to purchase a replacement or contact PMT directly for current parts availability.

source.content:
PRODUCTS
 Water Therapy Systems 
 The Arctic Ice Classic– Cold Water Therapy Device with Large Back Pad for Treatment of Disability

 Roll over to zoom in

 + View large image

 The Arctic Ice Classic– Cold Water Therapy Device with Large Back Pad for Treatment of Disability

 THERAPEUTIC COLD WATER: The Arctic Ice cold therapy machine uses a continuous flow of cold water to provide reduction of swelling and inflammation for those with a disability

 PORTABLE AND QUIET: Designed for easy portability and storage, this compact ice therapy system has a quiet motor for use in the home or hospital.

 DIGITAL CONTROLS: The built-in LCD screen and adjustable settings give you an easy way to control the treatment time and motor intensity as well as monitor water temperature. Convenient easy to read controls are at your fingertips.

 EASY TO ADD ICE: The insulated walls of the AIS allow you to see the fill line easily as well as monitor the ice level in your machine. You'll know right away when it's time to refill the unit to keep the cool flowing.

 Back PAD: Included with your Ice Machine is a Back therapy pad which can be utilized for coverage of the back or large body area. The flexible pad and device have insulated tubing to keep temps cooler longer.

 PRODUCT CODE: AISBACK

 THERAPY INFO

 WARRANTY

 DESCRIPTION
 The Arctic Ice is an ice therapy machine with a clear, insulated cooler basin and tubing, digital controls, and a multi-use therapy pad. The AIS has the ability to control the length of treatment time, up to 30 minutes, and adjust the intensity of the pressure by Liters Per Minute (LPM). The temperature monitor and the ability to see through to the ice levels means you always have your cryo treatment in the correct range. 

Includes: Back cold therapy pack X1 Insulated circulating water tube X1 Elastic bandages X3 DC 12V power adapter X1 Nonwoven barrier X1 Product User Manual X1 

 SPECIFICATIONS

 Product Weight (lbs) : 1

source.heading: NERVESPA   SILVER CONDUCTIVE GLOVE - HAND GARMENT SYSTEM INCLUDES DEVICE
source.content:
PRODUCTS
 Electrotherapy Devices • Neuropathy Stimulator 
 NERVESPA SILVER CONDUCTIVE GLOVE - HAND GARMENT SYSTEM INCLUDES DEVICE

 Roll over to zoom in

 + View large image

 NERVESPA SILVER CONDUCTIVE GLOVE - HAND GARMENT SYSTEM INCLUDES DEVICE

 Same technical specs as the Nerve Spa foot bath  
 Foot garment system is lightweight and highly portable        
 Touch screen device
 Built-in Microprocessor 
 7.83Hz, 80Hz, Symmetrical Biphasic Square, and Monophasic Waveform
 Reinforced lead wires
 Includes 1 Pair of Gloves
 FDA Registered
 Includes 24oz of conductive Spray

CONTACT FOR PRICING

 PRODUCT CODE: NSGG10

 THERAPY INFO

 WARRANTY

 DESCRIPTION

The Nerve Spa Pro is an Advanced Nerve and Neuropathy stimulator that utilizes a proprietary hybrid of electrotherapy including enhanced micro-current, galvanic, and TENS formulated into a proprietary specification—coupled with a monophasic waveform to target pain associated with early-onset peripheral neuropathy, as well other nerve-based pain conditions in the hands and feet.

 Circumferential Nerve Stimulation Treatment

 Surrounds the feet with a soothing and uniform level of current that relieves pain.

 Damaged Nerve Repair

 Increases the body's blood circulation, relaxes inflamed nerves, and works on a cellular level to stimulate the body's own healing mechanisms and repair damaged nerves.

 60-90-Day, Drug-Free Treatment to Reduce Pain

 Using the Nerve Spa over the course of 60 days or longer achieves an aggregate therapeutic effect that works to reverse and relieve peripheral neuropathy and other nerve-based pain conditions.

Aquatic Electrotherapy Stimulation

 7.83Hz Symmetrical Biphasic Square & Monophasic Waveform

 The Symmetrical Biphasic wave helps quell pain, while the Monophasic waveform pushes fluids and enhances pain relief in one's extremities.

 Rechargeable Battery

 Touch Screen Device with Two Modes of Operation

• Foot/hand garment system is lightweight and highly portable

Therapy description:
The Nerve Spa Pro is an advanced nerve and neuropathy stimulator that utilizes a proprietary hybrid of electrotherapy including enhanced micro-current, galvanic, and TENS formulated into a proprietary specification—coupled with a monophasic waveform to target pain associated with early-onset peripheral neuropathy, as well other nerve-based pain conditions in the hands and feet.

Key therapy concepts:
• Circumferential Nerve Stimulation Treatment – surrounds the area (such as feet or hands) with a soothing and uniform level of current that relieves pain.
• Damaged Nerve Repair – increases the body’s blood circulation, relaxes inflamed nerves, and works on a cellular level to stimulate the body’s own healing mechanisms and repair damaged nerves.
• 60–90-day, drug-free treatment approach – using the Nerve Spa over the course of 60 days or longer aims to achieve an aggregate therapeutic effect that works to reverse and relieve nerve-related pain.

For pricing and purchase details, PMT directs customers to contact the company directly or visit: https://paintechnology.com

source.content:
PRODUCTS
 Electrotherapy Devices • TENS 
 Wireless TENS Unit Stimulator by iTENS – Bluetooth Enabled TENS Device with Free App, for Back Pain, Knee Pain, and Other Joint Relief. Patented Mechanical Wings and Rechargeable Battery - Small Green

 Roll over to zoom in

 + View large image

 Wireless TENS Unit Stimulator by iTENS – Bluetooth Enabled TENS Device with Free App, for Back Pain, Knee Pain, and Other Joint Relief. Patented Mechanical Wings and Rechargeable Battery - Small Green

 REVOLUTIONARY APP-CONTROLLED DESIGN - The world's first FDA-cleared, OTC, wireless TENS therapy device that is controlled with an IOS or Android based app on your smartphone. Generation 2 devices have been upgraded to include compatibility with even more smart phones and tablets

 ROTATING ULTRA FLEXIBLE WINGS - This second generation of iTENS utilizes a brand new rotating wing design which gives 360 degrees of movement for full range-of-motion. The new wings are thinner and more flexible than ever for maximum comfort and utility with a laser printed silver conductive surface.

 CUSTOMIZABLE SETTINGS - Choose programs based on body part, pain condition, or make a custom manual program.

 PAIN RELIEF WITHOUT MEDICATIONS - Transcutaneous Electrical Nerve Stimulation, or TENS, works by sending tiny electrical signals through the skin to intercept pain signals from reaching the brain, and help release endorphins, the body's natural pain-fighting chemical.

 TRACK YOUR RESULTS - Track your pain relief results before and after each session and see your long term results over time. iTENS lets you measure and report your pain scale, tracks your results, and charts your progress.

 PRODUCT CODE: ITENSSMGREEN G2

 THERAPY INFO

 WARRANTY

 Large Blue

 Small Green

 Large Gray

 Small Red

 DESCRIPTION
 iTENS Device - Wireless Electrotherapy
Pain relief meets wearable tech: The First App-Controlled Wireless TENS Pain Relief Device. 

The most advanced TENS device on the market with a beautifully designed APP.

The iTENS gives you the versatility needed for pain relief in those smaller areas, large areas and flexible parts. The patented motion mechanical wings grip and move easily on your ankle, knee, elbow, wrist, and other small treatment areas. The iTENS will give you up to 24 hours of use per charge for continuous pain relief. The gel pads are good for 10-12 applications. 

Includes: 
iTENS Device with rechargeable lithium-ion battery 
One set of reusable Gel Pads 
Charging dock with USB charging cable 
Instructions 

"Works really well. I love not having wires attached to it!"
- Brian C. 

"I have tried many other electrotherapy devices on the market but wasn'thappy with the results until I stumbled across the iTens. The product works wirelessly with my iPhone and there's no cords to get in the way. It's an extremely practical device for someone who travels a lot like myself."
- Blake G. 

"I have finally found a solution for my arthritic aches and pains!" 
- R. Cooper 

"I fell 2 stories at age 3, and my pain got so bad as an adult that I couldn't do a lot of everyday things. I've been using my itens for about 4 months now. I'm able to finally sit through SS and church service. I can go on car rides to visit friends and family. I end up turning it up pretty high the longer I sit, but it helps a lot! It's given me some of my life back". 
- Kasey S.

 SPECIFICATIONS

 Product Weight (lbs) : 0.25Length (cm) : 25Width (cm) : 15Height (cm) : 5Color : Small Green

Red light at 660 nm is positioned for surface-level tissue exposure, while infrared light at 830 nm and 850 nm are intended for surface and deeper thermal support.  Muscle and joint discomfort – temporary relief for minor muscle and joint pain.

source.content:
PRODUCTS
 Therapeutic Creams and Gels 
 NERVE TARGET ROLL-ON GEL - Targeted Therapeutic treatment for Damaged Nerves, Intractable Back Pain, Joint Aches and Muscles Spasms. 

 Roll over to zoom in

 + View large image

 NERVE TARGET ROLL-ON GEL - Targeted Therapeutic treatment for Damaged Nerves, Intractable Back Pain, Joint Aches and Muscles Spasms. 

 SUPPORTS TARGETED COOLING & SENSORY MODULATION
(Menthol + Camphor)

 SUPPORTS LOCAL MICRO-CIRCULATION
(Eucalyptus + Witch Hazel + Arnica)

 PROMOTES RAPID TOPICAL ABSORPTION
(Plant-Based Carrier System)

 PRODUCT CODE: NTROLL

 THERAPY INFO

 WARRANTY

 DESCRIPTION

Nerve Target Roll-On Gel: Science-Led Topical Sensory & Microvascular Support

Localized musculoskeletal discomfort is commonly associated with transient inflammatory mediator signaling, altered peripheral sensory receptor activation, and microvascular circulation shifts.

Nerve Target Roll-On Gel is a clinician-developed topical formulation designed to support sensory receptor modulation and localized circulation using counterirritant compounds and botanical extracts evaluated in controlled human research.*

Formulation Strategy: Convergent Sensory & Circulatory Support

This formulation integrates TRP-channel activators, vasomodulatory botanicals, and antioxidant-rich plant extracts studied for their roles in sensory signaling and localized comfort.

TRP Channel Sensory Modulation

Menthol

Menthol activates TRPM8 receptors and has been evaluated in controlled human trials for topical cooling-mediated analgesic effects.

Camphor

Camphor has been studied for topical counterirritant effects and modulation of peripheral sensory receptors.

Microcirculatory Support

Eucalyptus (Eucalyptus globulus leaf)

Eucalyptus oil has been evaluated in human trials examining anti-inflammatory and topical comfort endpoints.

Arnica

Studied in randomized controlled trials evaluating musculoskeletal comfort.

Botanical Antioxidant Support

Camellia sinensis (Green Tea Leaf)

Evaluated in human research for antioxidant and inflammatory biomarker modulation.

Dosing & Application

Apply to affected area up to 3–4 times daily.
For external use only.

Designed for localized use as part of a comprehensive musculoskeletal support strategy.

Formulation Standards

 Third-party laboratory tested
 No artificial dyes
 Manufactured in the USA in GMP-compliant facilities

Selected Clinical Research Context

The ingredient components within this formulation have been evaluated in controlled human trials examining sensory receptor activation, topical analgesic endpoints, inflammatory biomarker modulation, and musculoskeletal function outcomes.

Menthol (TRPM8 activation)

Galeotti et al., Pain (2002)
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/12406524/

Camphor

Xu et al., Journal of Neuroscience (2005)
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15987771/

Arnica (Topical)

Widrig et al., Rheumatology International (2007)
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/17318618/

Eucalyptus Oil (Topical)

Jun et al., Evidence-Based Complementary and Alternative Medicine (2013))
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/23662106/

These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

 SPECIFICATIONS

  - Targeted therapeutic support for:

  - **Roll-on gel** for easy, mess-minimizing application directly to the area of concern.

source.content:
PRODUCTS
 Water Therapy Systems 
 Cryotherapy and Hot Water Treatement System - Water Circulating Device by Aqua Relief with Universal Pad For Post-Surgical Recovery and Sustained Heat Therapy to Treat a Chronic or Acute Disability - With Back pad

 Roll over to zoom in

 + View large image

 Cryotherapy and Hot Water Treatement System - Water Circulating Device by Aqua Relief with Universal Pad For Post-Surgical Recovery and Sustained Heat Therapy to Treat a Chronic or Acute Disability - With Back pad

 HOW IS THIS HOT AND COLD THERAPY UNIT USED: Hot and cold water is quietly circulated through the leak-free 52 hose to the pad, giving your body complete hot or cold coverage. Add ice and the cryo-cool system circulates cold water for up to 5 hours; while the heating system revs up in less than 10 minutes and can give you the desired heat level.

 UNIVERSAL WRAP: The universal wrap is 11x 11 and includes a 3x39 Velcro strap for use with a variety of areas like the hip, ankle, wrist, shoulder, leg, or elbow. Additional pad designs are sold separately.

 LONG DURATION HEAT USAGE: Low level heat can be used for long duration treatment on those with disabilities.

 ICE Therapy:Use cold water to reduce edema and swelling

 INDICATION FOR USE: For use in in Hospital setting to treat chronic and acute disabilities.

 PRODUCT CODE: ARSwBACK

 THERAPY INFO

 WARRANTY

 DESCRIPTION
 For proper use: Always have water above the fill-line Not for commercial/continuous use – pump life expectancy is 1700 hours. Empty water from the reservoir between sessions. Unplug in between sessions. The Aqua Relief System hot and cold water therapy machine is hospital grade for chronic disabilities.  The Aqua Relief System cold and hot water therapy unit gives your body localized circumferential continuous coverage. Hot and cold water is circulated through whichever pad you choose, giving that specific area complete hot or cold coverage. The cryo-cool system circulates cold water (fill the unit with ice and water) for up to 4 hours; while the heating system revs up in less than 10 minutes and can give you the desired heat level for as long as you need it.

 SPECIFICATIONS

The Rapid Knee OA Brace - Small Right (Dual Upright Hinged, Lightweight & Breathable) is designed as a portable, supportive knee brace for people with osteoarthritis or rheumatoid arthritis.

Key points from the PMT product information:

- **Portable comfort**: The brace is made to be easy to take with you and wear throughout the day—at home or on the go—so you can have consistent support wherever you are.

- **Breathable and lightweight**: It uses breathable, non-allergenic materials to help keep your skin cooler and more comfortable, even during extended wear. The lightweight build helps reduce bulk and fatigue while wearing it.

- **Adjustable control and support (Dual Upright Hinged)**: The dual upright hinged design allows you to adjust the level of support to your needs. This helps you customize how much stabilization and control the brace provides as part of your recovery or daily management.

- **User-friendly design**: It includes an indexed hinge that makes it easier to track range-of-motion (ROM) changes over time. The brace offers both dynamic and static setting options, so it can be used in different ways as your rehabilitation or support needs change.

Overall, it’s a right-leg, small-size OA knee brace focused on comfort, adjustability, and ease of daily use.

For full product details, sizing, or ordering, you can also visit: https://paintechnology.com/category

response.answer:
Ottossage Ottoman Foot Massager is a massage therapy device offered by PMT. It is not a TENS unit, but a full-featured foot massager and ottoman designed for comfort and therapeutic foot treatment.

Here are the key details PMT provides:

- **Product Type**: Massaging ottoman that converts into a foot massager.
- **Functions**:
  - Air compression
  - Shiatsu-style kneading via roller balls
  - Intense vibration
  - Therapeutic heat
- **Usage Options**:
  - Use as a traditional ottoman with the top lid on for a relaxing vibration plate under your feet.
  - Remove the lid to access the full foot-massage compartment with compression and rollers.
- **Power**:
  - Built-in **li‑ion rechargeable battery** (approx. 3 hours of use per charge)
  - Can also be plugged in for **continuous use**.
- **Massage Programs & Adjustability**:
  - Three main massage tool combinations:
    1. Compression with rollers
    2. Compression without rollers
    3. Vibration with rollers
  - Multiple intensity levels for each program so you can adjust strength to comfort.
- **Heat Therapy**:
  - Optional heated foot massage setting for a deeper therapeutic effect.
  - Marketed for helping relieve pain from **plantar fasciitis**, increasing blood flow, reducing stress, and helping expel lactic acid while you relax.
- **Design & Maintenance**:
  - High-end, living-room–friendly ottoman appearance.
  - Washable interior fabric liner for easier cleaning where the feet go.

For current availability, pricing, or a full spec sheet, visit PMT’s website product catalog:
https://paintechnology.com/category

If you want, share how you plan to use it (e.g., plantar fasciitis, general foot fatigue), and I can highlight which features would be most relevant for you.

payload.chatInput: What information does PMT provide about Joint Stimulator?

response.answer:
Pain Management Technologies (PMT) explains that a TENS (Transcutaneous Electrical Nerve Stimulation) unit is a small, battery-powered electrotherapy device used to help relieve pain, including joint-related pain, by sending low-voltage electrical pulses through electrodes placed on the skin.

Key points PMT provides about its TENS units that are relevant for joint use:

- **How it works**: The unit sends gentle electrical impulses through electrode pads into the nerves under the skin. This can:
  - Help block pain signals before they reach the brain
  - Help the body release natural pain-relieving chemicals (endorphins)

- **Intended uses**: PMT notes that TENS may provide relief for many pain conditions, including:
  - Arthritis and aching joints
  - Sports injuries
  - Back pain, sciatica, muscular strains, rheumatism, neuralgia, and various acute and chronic pain conditions

- **Features commonly highlighted** (for home-use TENS units):
  - Adjustable intensity levels
  - Multiple modes/programs for different pain types
  - Dual channels (allowing use of 2–4 electrodes at once, helpful for areas like knees, shoulders, or multiple joints)
  - Selectable pulse rate, pulse width, and timer functions
  - Portable, pocket-sized design with battery power

- **Relief patterns**: PMT notes that some users feel relief only while the unit is on, while others may have pain relief that continues for a time after the session ends. Results vary from person to person and pain type.

- **General notes**:
  - TENS is described as a non-drug, electrotherapy option for managing pain.
  - Correct electrode pad placement is important for effectiveness.

If you’re asking about a specific PMT TENS model for joint pain (for example, Ultima 5 or Ultima 20), tell me which device you have so I can provide more tailored details from PMT’s information.

payload.chatInput: What should I know about Electrotherapy Supplies from PMT?

response.answer:
Pain Management Technologies (PMT) offers several key TENS-related supplies and accessories designed to keep your electrotherapy treatments effective, comfortable, and safe.

Here are the main supply types you should know about, based on PMT’s catalog:

1. **Lead Wires (Cables from Unit to Pads)**
   - PMT provides **Universal TENS Lead Wires** that fit most TENS and EMS units using standard 2 mm pigtail-style electrodes.
   - Available in two main grades:
     - **Standard Grade (Product Code: LWS)**
       - 12 copper strands
       - Typical lifespan: about **6–12 months** for heavy users
       - 48-inch length
       - 1 pair per pack (connects up to 4 electrodes)
       - Designed as a reliable everyday option
     - **Premium Grade (Tiger Lead Wires – Product Code: P-LWT)**
       - Extra thick construction with **24 copper strands**
       - More durable and better electrical conduction than standard wires
       - Typical lifespan: about **1–2 years** for heavy users
       - 48-inch length
       - 1 pair per pack (connects up to 4 electrodes)
       - Marketed as **“extra strong”** and **premium** for long life use
   - Why this matters:
     - Worn-out lead wires can cause **inconsistent stimulation, shocks, or jolts**.
     - Replacing old or damaged wires helps maintain **smooth, comfortable therapy**.

2. **Compatibility**
   - PMT’s universal lead wires are designed with a **standard shielded plastic female right-angle plug** and **standard 2 mm pin connectors**.
   - They are described as fitting **most electrotherapy devices and TENS/EMS electrodes** that use these standard connectors.

3. **What’s Typically Included with Devices**
   - Many PMT devices, such as advanced TENS/EMS units, come with:
     - The **TENS/EMS device**
     - **Lead wires** (usually 1–2 pairs)
     - A starter set of **self-adhesive electrode pads**
     - **Batteries or rechargeable power**, depending on the model
     - **Instruction manual**
   - Over time, you’ll mainly replace:
     - **Lead wires** (if they wear out or start causing irregular stimulation)
     - **Electrode pads** (when they lose stickiness or comfort)

4. **Maintenance & Replacement Considerations**
   - Monitor lead wires for:
     - Visible damage, fraying, or kinks
     - Sensations of **sudden shocks or jolts** during use
   - When you notice these issues, PMT recommends replacing the lead wires to maintain **optimal therapy results**.

5. **Where to View or Purchase PMT Supplies**
   - Full catalog and purchasing options are available on PMT’s website:
     - Product catalog: https://paintechnology.com/category
     - Electrotherapy supplies section will list **lead wires, electrodes, and related accessories**.

If you tell me which PMT TENS unit you have (for example, Ultima 5, Ultima 20, Touch Stim, etc.), I can narrow down exactly which lead wires and supplies are the best match for your specific device.

payload.chatInput: Can you explain the PMT information about Specialty Gel Pads?

response.answer:
Pain Management Technologies (PMT) offers several lines of specialty gel electrodes designed for TENS, EMS, interferential, microcurrent, and galvanic stimulation devices. Here’s a concise breakdown of the key features from the PMT information:

1. **Soft-Touch Premium / Specialty Design**  
   - Multi-layer construction typically includes: a non-porous tricot or cloth backing, a conductive wire-mount layer, a high-quality carbon conductive layer, and an extra-thick adhesive gel.  
   - The **extra-thick gel** is designed to improve comfort, adhesion, and current distribution over repeated uses.  
   - Electrodes use an **ultra-tight pigtail pin connector**, compatible with most TENS/EMS units that use standard 2 mm pin leads.  
   - **Oval corners** help reduce edge curl, which improves contact and durability.  
   - All pads use **latex-free gel**, with a **resealable pouch** to help keep the gel fresh.

2. **Soft-Touch Carbon Electrodes – Cloth Back (PMT Gel)**  
   - Self-adhesive, high-quality gel electrodes (about **45 ohms of resistance**).  
   - **Reusable for ~10–15 or more uses per pad**, depending on how long each session is and how well they’re cared for.  
   - Available in multiple shapes/sizes (e.g., **2" x 2" square, round sizes, butterfly 6" x 3.3"**).  
   - Universal for most TENS, EMS, interferential, and Russian units with pin-type connectors.  
   - PMT notes that the lifespan can be enhanced by applying **a small drop of water** on the gel after use and immediately returning pads to the **airtight pouch**.  
   - Recommended to **replace electrodes once the gel wears down**, typically after about 10–15 uses.

3. **Soft-Touch Carbon Electrodes – Foam Back (PMT Gel)**  
   - Same general electrical function (carbon conductor, pigtail pin) but with a **foam backing** instead of cloth.  
   - Foam backing is designed **not to absorb sweat**, making it helpful in **moist or more active environments**.  
   - Uses an **Ag (silver) conductor** for consistent performance and good current dispersion.  
   - Prewired, reusable, and compatible with TENS, EMS, interferential, microcurrent, and galvanic generators.

4. **Soft-Touch Medical Grade / Clinical Grade Electrodes**  
   - Similar construction philosophy (self-adhesive, high-quality gel, 45 ohms of resistance).  
   - Designed for **clinical or higher-demand use**, with emphasis on consistent dispersion and durability.  
   - Available in multiple formats (squares, rounds, butterfly).

5. **General Use & Care Guidance from PMT**  
   - Average **usable life** is about **10–15 sessions per pad**, sometimes more with careful handling.  
   - **Do not wash or soak TENS pads in water**—this can damage the gel and reduce adhesion and performance.  
   - To extend life, PMT specifically recommends:  
     - Rub **a small drop of water** onto the gel surface after use (do not rinse or soak).  
     - Immediately place the electrodes back on the **plastic liner** and into the **air-tight, resealable pouch**.  
   - Replace pads when:  
     - The gel is visibly worn, dry, or uneven.  
     - Adhesion is clearly reduced, or stimulation feels inconsistent.

If you tell me what kind of use you have in mind (e.g., home TENS unit, clinic setting, area of the body, need for sweat-resistant backing, or sensitivity to adhesives), I can narrow down which PMT specialty gel electrode line is likely the best match for that use case.

   - To extend life, PMT specifically recommends:  
     - Rub **a small drop of water** onto the gel surface after use (do not rinse or soak).  
     - Immediately place the electrodes back on the **plastic liner** and into the **air-tight, resealable pouch**.  
   - Replace pads when:  
     - The gel is visibly worn, dry, or uneven.  
     - Adhesion is clearly reduced, or stimulation feels inconsistent.

If you tell me what kind of use you have in mind (e.g., home TENS unit, clinic setting, area of the body, need for sweat-resistant backing, or sensitivity to adhesives), I can narrow down which PMT specialty gel electrode line is likely the best match for that use case."}

 Mobility Assistance 
 Mobi-Bench - Bath/Shower Transfer Bench with Swivel Chair

 Mobi-Bench - Bath/Shower Transfer Bench with Swivel Chair

 SWIVEL SEAT – The swivel seat allows for an easy in and out directional adjustment. Positioning the user optimally.
 MEDICAL GRADE - sliding transfer shower and bath bench provides safe and easy access for seniors and low ambulatory people. Effortless sliding seat and pivoting chair for safe, easy transfers in and out of the tub.
 PADDED PARTS - Our cushiony padded seat and armrests are warm to the touch, anti-slip, and durable. Comfort and safety is top priority with slip-resistant padding on all main components and leg caps. The medical-grade, closed-cell molded polyurethane padding on this shower chair for the bathtub will not absorb any water and is easy to clean and disinfect.
 COMPACT DESIGN - The swivel seat is safe and effective for created bathroom safety. The Mobi Bench is compact and wont protrude into the room as much as traditional transfer benches.
 WEIGHT-BEARING – The Mobi Bench is padded and durably constructed with reinforced arm rests, seat and components. Unlike standard chairs with no armrests, the robust armrests on the Carousel can be leaned on to help the user into and out of the chair. They also provide important additional physical and mental support against slips and falls and fear of slips and falls.
 COLOR FOR SAFETY. Our cool blue color makes the essential parts of this handicap shower chair with arms much easier to see by vision-impaired users increasing safety. Rather than blending in with the background like old-style white benches, the blue contrast color helps users distinguish the chair from the bath/shower area and significantly reduces slips, trips and falls.
 DESIGNED FOR: People with permanent mobility disabilities.

 PRODUCT CODE: MBTB

 THERAPY INFO

 WARRANTY

 DESCRIPTION
 360° Swivel Seat
Increase mobility and safety

The swivel seat offers a safer, easier to use and more comfortable way to transfer one from outside to inside their bathing area. Standard fixed seats create sharp movement points increasing the likelihood of a fall.  Enabling the bench to protrude less into the room than a traditional transfer bench.

Pivoting Armrests

Increase easy-in and easy-out access

The padded arm rests can be raised and lowered and locked into place. The armrests give the user leverage to get up and out of the chair safely.

Easy Glide Sliding

Increase safety

The sliding function of the Carousel prevents slips, trips, falls and even skin tears by keeping the user secure in the seat while transferring in and out of the tub/shower. Simply loosen the knob below the seat, glide down the rail, then tighten the knob again to lock the seat in place.

Padded Seat, Back, and Armrests

Waterproof padding provides comfort

Warm to the touch, non-slip, comfort awaits.  All leg feet are non-slip and designed for maximim safety. 

Height Adjustable Legs

Adjustable without tools

The height is adjustable to fit shallow or deep tubs or showers.

Bright Blue

High-Contrast Color for Best Visibility

Bright blue coloration is best for vision impaired and/or dementia afflicted users. Rather than blending in with the background like old-style white benches, the blue contrast color helps users distinguish the chair from its surroundings and significantly reduces slips, trips and falls.

Note: Please review dimensions carefully before ordering. Chair requires 3" clearance from nearest wall or obstruction to fully rotate.

source.content:
PRODUCTS
 Massage Therapy Devices 
 Nerve Spa Vibe | Deep Tissue Vibrational Massager with Attachement Heads | 7500 RPM Vibration Therapy for Deep Tissue Sciatica, Neuropathy, Joint & Muscle Relief | Cordless, Compact & Powerful.

 Roll over to zoom in

 + View large image

 Nerve Spa Vibe | Deep Tissue Vibrational Massager with Attachement Heads | 7500 RPM Vibration Therapy for Deep Tissue Sciatica, Neuropathy, Joint & Muscle Relief | Cordless, Compact & Powerful.

Clinical Device

High-Frequency Vibration for Clinic Workflows & Home-Care Continuity

 Relieve Pain – Helps reduce muscle, joint, and nerve-related discomfort.
 Stimulate Nerves – High-frequency vibration supports nerve activation and sensory input.
 Improve Circulation – Supports blood flow and localized tissue perfusion.
 Relax Muscles – Helps release tension and reduce stiffness.
 Support Recovery – Useful for rehab, warm-up, and post-treatment recovery.

 PRODUCT CODE: NSVibe

 THERAPY INFO

 WARRANTY

 DESCRIPTION

Clinical Overview

High-Speed Vibration Therapy Designed for Fast, Focused Clinical Use

The NerveSpa Vibe is a high-frequency vibration tool designed to help clinicians target deep tissue, joint regions, and nerve-rich areas with short, focused sessions. With output up to approximately 7,000 rpm, the Vibe supports neuropathy, scar tissue release, muscle tension reduction, joint mobility work, and recovery-oriented soft-tissue care.

Its compact cordless form makes it easy to use around treatment tables, chairs, and rehab spaces without adding complexity to the visit. Four color-coded speed levels, a built-in 10-minute auto timer, and a rechargeable lithium battery support repeatable sessions that can be standardized across care pathways.

Clinical Applications

Versatile Across Neuropathy, Mobility, Scar Tissue, and Recovery Protocols

 Neuropathy programs – vibration to feet, calves, and hands to support comfort and circulation.
 Scar tissue and adhesions – focused vibration over restricted fascial planes.
 Joint mobility – peri-joint soft tissue for stiffness and reduced range of motion.
 Myofascial trigger points and muscle tension – localized high-frequency vibration.
 Warm-up or cool-down adjunct – useful for rehab and performance programs.

Key Focus Areas: Neuropathy support • Scar tissue & adhesions • Joint mobility • Trigger points • Recovery & warm-up

High-Frequency Vibration Features

Compact, Cordless, and Built for Repeatable Short Sessions

 High-Speed Output – four speed settings up to ~7,000 rpm for gentle to intense deep-tissue vibration.
 Color-Coded Speed Levels – Blue ~4,000 rpm, Green ~5,000 rpm, Yellow ~6,000 rpm, Red ~7,000 rpm.
 Compact & Cordless – lightweight one-hand form factor for easy movement around the table or chair.
 10-Minute Auto Timer – helps standardize session length and preserve battery life.
 Interchangeable Attachment Heads – supports both broad and pinpoint contact across different tissue targets.
 Pressure Overload Protection – helps protect the motor when excessive pressure is applied.

Clinical Pathways

Designed for Use In Clinic and as Part of Home-Care Continuity

Neuropathy Support

Apply high-frequency vibration to plantar surfaces, calves, or hands for short intervals as part of a broader neuropathy program that may also include electrotherapy, foot bath, and lifestyle support. This pathway is aimed at supporting comfort, circulation, and sensory awareness.

Joint Mobility & Range of Motion

Use around knees, shoulders, hips, ankles, and wrists to relax peri-articular soft tissues prior to mobilization, stretching, or exercise. This may help patients move more comfortably into loaded positions or rehab activities.

Scar Tissue & Adhesions

Focused vibration may be used along surgical scars or chronic adhesions, when clinically appropriate, to help loosen stiff fascial layers and improve tissue glide. This can be combined with manual therapy and stretching.

Trigger Points & Muscle Tension

Pinpoint attachment heads allow targeted work on myofascial trigger points in the neck, shoulders, low back, and extremities—especially when time is limited and the goal is fast, localized tissue preparation or relief.

Note: All protocols are determined by the supervising clinician and should be adapted to individual patient tolerance, comorbidities, and the overall care plan. Avoid direct use over the carotid sinus, eyes, open wounds, or any areas contraindicated for vibration or manual therapy.

Technical Specifications

Core Device Specs

 Category
 Specification

 Device Type
 High-frequency handheld vibration massager for clinical and clinic-directed home-use environments, per provider guidelines.

 Motor & Speed
 High-speed motor up to ~7,000 rpm with four discrete speed levels indicated by a colored LED ring.

 Battery
 2,500 mAh rechargeable lithium battery.

 Charging
 USB Type-C, 5V / 2A.

 Charge Time
 Approximately 4 hours.

 Working Time
 Approximately 50 minutes of continuous use, depending on speed and load.

 Controls
 Single-button interface that cycles through speed levels; integrated 10-minute auto timer.

 Form Factor
 Lightweight cylindrical body with dual side heads; compact footprint fits easily in a drawer, case, or small treatment cart.

 Attachment Heads
 Multiple head options for broader or more pinpoint contact areas depending on tissue target and clinical judgment.

 Safety Feature
 Integrated power-overload protection to help protect the motor during excessive pressure.

Use should follow standard vibration therapy precautions and be adapted to patient tolerance and clinical judgment. Patients with implanted electronic devices or significant cardiovascular, neurological, or metabolic conditions should be evaluated carefully by the supervising provider prior to use.

 SPECIFICATIONS

 Product Weight (lbs) : 1

response.answer:
Cold and hot water therapy systems from PMT are designed to circulate temperature-controlled water through specialized pads to provide localized therapy for injuries, post-surgical recovery, and chronic conditions.

From the available information:

1. **Water Therapy Coupling Converter (TP2020-CC / TP2020-CC-White)**
   - Converts otherwise incompatible cryotherapy/hot-water therapy machines so they can use **PMT brand water therapy pads**.
   - Replaces existing fittings on many circulating water therapy systems so you can attach PMT pads.
   - Uses **quick-connect / disconnect couplings** for easier, more secure, and less leaky connections than some competitor products.
   - Intended for use with **both hot and cold** water therapy units.
   - Sold **as an accessory only** – does **not** include a cryotherapy machine or universal pad.
   - Product code examples: **TP2020-CC** and **TP2020-CC-White**.
   - Purpose: lets you use PMT’s hospital-grade pads to treat a wide variety of symptoms and body areas with circulating water therapy.

2. **General Water Therapy Pad/System Features (from PMT descriptions)**
   - Pads are described as **hospital grade equipment** meant to deliver professional quality treatment at home.
   - Used for:
     - Post-surgical recovery
     - Traumatic injuries
     - Chronic issues
   - Cold water therapy units (cryo cool units):
     - Provide **localized cooling relief** to help reduce swelling and manage discomfort.
     - Circulate ice-cold water around the injured body part for **continuous flow** and consistent temperature.
     - Allow more joint movement compared to loose ice packs that can slip or fall off.
   - Pads can typically be used with **both hot and cold** units (when the underlying unit supports both).

3. **Aqua Relief System (example of a hot/cold water therapy device)**
   - Hospital-grade hot and cold water therapy machine for **chronic disabilities**.
   - Circulates hot or cold water through selected pads to give the targeted area **circumferential continuous coverage**.
   - Cold mode (cryo-cool): fill with ice and water; circulates cold water for **up to ~4 hours**.
   - Hot mode: heats up in **less than 10 minutes** and can maintain desired heat levels as long as needed (within proper use guidelines).
   - Use instructions highlight:
     - Always keep water **above the fill line**.
     - **Not for commercial/continuous** 24/7 use – pump life expectancy is about **1700 hours**.
     - **Empty the reservoir** between sessions.
     - **Unplug** the unit between sessions.

4. **Other Water Therapy System Mentions (product family overview)**
   PMT lists multiple water therapy and cryotherapy products, for example:
   - **Arctic Ice Clear** – cold water therapy device (with large back pad)
   - **Arctic Ice Classic** – cold water therapy device (with large back pad)
   - **Polar Sport Mini – 5L** – cold water therapy device with universal pad
   - **Polar Vortex** – cold water therapy device with universal pad
   - **Cryotherapy and Hot Water Treatment System by Aqua Relief** – hot/cold water circulation with universal or back pad
   - **Water Circulating Heated Mattress Pad / Sleep Pad (Thermacycle)** – water-based heated or cooled mattress pads for sleep comfort and temperature management
   - **Cold water therapy pads** (e.g., elbow pad) and **Y-splitter hoses** for dual-appendage use
   - **Cold Water Therapy Couplings for Arctic Ice Clear** – replacement couplings for certain units

5. **Where to explore full details**
   For complete product specs, manuals, and videos for water therapy systems and pads, you can browse PMT’s resources and catalog:
   - Resources & manuals: https://paintechnology.com/resources
   - Product catalog (Water Therapy Systems category): https://paintechnology.com/category

If you tell me which specific water therapy unit or accessory you’re interested in (for example, Aqua Relief, Arctic Ice Clear, Polar Sport Mini, or the Coupling Converter), I can narrow this down to just that product’s information.

payload.chatInput: I need details on Dynamic Wedge Lumbar - adaptor/charger. What does PMT say about it?

response.answer:
For the Dynamic Wedge Lumbar (back pain) unit, Pain Management Technologies treats the power supply as a simple replacement charger/adaptor rather than a separate, configurable battery system.

From PMT product information:

- The official replacement adaptor/charger for the Dynamic Wedge Lumbar is listed as:
  - **Product name:** Dynamic Wedge Lumbar – adaptor/charger
  - **Product code:** **DWL-charger**
  - **Description:** Replacement charger for the Dynamic Wedge Lumbar traction device
  - **Listed weight:** 1 lb (for the packaged charger/accessory)

PMT does **not** publish detailed battery specifications (mAh, chemistry, voltage, etc.) in the product description or accessory listing. The focus is on ensuring you use the correct, approved replacement adaptor/charger for the device.

To purchase or confirm compatibility, PMT’s guidance is:
- Use the **Dynamic Wedge Lumbar – adaptor/charger (DWL-charger)** as the replacement
- For ordering, availability, or any battery‑specific questions (run time, replacement of internal battery, etc.), contact PMT customer service or visit the product/accessory pages on:
  - https://paintechnology.com
  - Product/accessory category page: https://paintechnology.com/category

If you tell me whether you need:
- a **replacement charger only**, or
- information on **battery life / internal battery replacement**

I can narrow down what PMT provides for that specific need.

payload.chatInput: Could you summarize PMT's information about Ultrasound device - 1 and 3Mhz?

response.answer:
Here’s a concise summary of PMT’s information about its 1 & 3 MHz ultrasound device (JUS-2):

- **Type of device**: Therapeutic ultrasound unit used for pain relief and muscle rehabilitation.
- **Frequencies**: Includes a **1 MHz** and **3 MHz** ultrasound applicator.
- **Modes**: Provides both **Continuous** and **Pulsed** ultrasound treatments.
- **Programs**: Has **4 preset programs** designed to help alleviate pain and support faster healing of injured tissues.
- **Interface & controls**:
  - Large **digital display** with **coupling indication** (helps confirm good contact during treatment)
  - **Capacitive, light-illuminated touch buttons**
  - Allows selection of **treatment time, duty cycle, and frequency**
- **Design & accessories**:
  - Lightweight and compact for easy handling
  - Includes **Ultrasound Applicator**, **Applicator Side Stand**, **Conductive Gel**, and a **Patient Safety Cable**
- **Regulatory**: Described as a **510(k)-approved** ultrasound therapy device.

This unit is intended for therapeutic ultrasound treatments, not as a traditional TENS (electrode pad-based) stimulator. For full details or to see all specs and resources, you can visit PMT’s Resources Page: https://paintechnology.com/resources

tests.question: Where is the right place to never place TENS pads?

source.question: Where should I never place TENS pads?
source.answer: TENS pads should never be placed on certain areas where stimulation could be unsafe, including: front or sides of neck (near the throat or carotid arteries). Across the chest or directly over the heart. On the head, face, or near the eyes. Inside the mouth or on broken skin. Over open wounds, sores, infections, or irritated skin. Directly over the spine or major bony areas. Across the abdomen or lower back during pregnancy UNLESS approved by a healthcare provider. Near implanted electronic devices (such as pacemakers or defibrillators).

tests.question: Could you explain this for me: Can TENS speed up healing or does it only mask pain?

source.question: Can TENS speed up healing or does it only mask pain?
source.answer: TENS is primarily used for pain relief, not to directly heal injuries. It helps by changing how pain signals are processed by the nervous system, which can make discomfort more manageable. By reducing pain, TENS may help some people move more comfortable, particupate in physical therapy, and stay active, which can support the overall recovery process. However, it does not repair damaged tissue or speed up healing on its own.

source.question: Is a prescription required?
source.answer: No, most TENS units do not require a prescription and are available for purchase without one. Many people use TENS at home as a drug-free option for managing pain. However, it is recommended to consult a healthcare provider before use if you have certain conditions, such as an implanted electronic device (like a pacemaker), pregnancy, epilepsy, or significant loss of sensation.

tests.question: Could you explain this for me: What pads are compatible with my unit?

source.question: What pads are compatible with my unit?
source.answer: Most TENS units work with standard snap-style electrode pads, but compatibility depends on your device's connector type. Most units follow a standard 2mm pin or snap connector size for electrodes. Before purchasing, check the following: The connector style on your TENS unit. The recommended pad size from your device manufacturer. Whether the pads are labeled for TENS use (not just other stimulation devices).

source.answer: Press and hold the power button for about 3 seconds to turn your Ultima 5 on. You'll see the green LED light up along with the display, and intensity always starts at zero so you can ease in comfortably. To power down, press and hold the same button again for 3 seconds.

tests.question: Can you explain the difference between 2 inch and 4 inch pads?

source.question: What's the difference between 2 inch and 4 inch pads?
source.answer: The main difference is coverage area. Larger pads spread stimulation over a wider area, while smaller pads provide more targeted treatment. 2 Inch Pads: Best for smaller or more precise areas like the wrist, ankle, neck muscles, or smaller joints. 4 Inch Pads: Better for larger muscle groups, like the lower back, shoulders, thighs, or areas with broader discomfort. Larger pads may also feel more comfortable because the stimulation is distributed across a bigger surface area.

tests.question: I need some clarification about this: I am experiencing skin irritation -- why is that.

source.question: I am experiencing skin irritation -- why is that?
source.answer: Skin irriation after using a TENS unit is usually caused by skin sensitivity, electrode adhesive, or improper pad use. Common causes include: Sensitivity to the electrode gel or adhesive: Some people may have mild skin reactions to the materials in the pads. Using pads for too long: Extended use in the same area can irritate the skin. Worn or dirty electrodes: Old pads may not distribute stimulation evenly and can increase irritation. Applying pads to unprepared skin: Lotions, oils, sweat, or dirt can affect adhesion and skin comfort. Stimulation intensity is too high: Excessive intensity may cause discomfort or irritation. To reduce irritation: Apply pads to clean, dry skin. Rotate pad placement between sessions. Avoid using pads on irritated, broken, or sensitive skin. Lower the intensity if the sensation feels uncomfortable. Replace pads when they become dry or worn.

source.answer: You get three: asymmetrical, symmetrical, and monophasic. Switch between them by pressing "PR-" and "PW-" together. source.question: Why isn't my TENS unit producing sensation?
source.answer: If you don't feel any simulation from your TENS unit, check these common causes; Intensity is too low: Gradually increase the intensity until you feel a comfortable tingling or pulsing sensation. Pads are not making good contact: Make sure pads are fully attached to clean, dry skin. Electrodes are worn out: Old or dry pads may not transfer stimulation properly. Pad placement needs adjustment: Try moving the pads closer to the area of treatment or adjusting their postion. Cable or connection issue: Make sure the leads are securely connected to both the unit and the pads. Low Battery: Replace or recharge the battery if the device is not powering correctly.

source.question: Why does the sensation fade after a few minutes?
source.answer: It is common for the TENS sensation to feel less noticeable after a few minutes. This happens because your nerves can adapt to the stimulation, making the sensation feel weaker over time. If this happens, you can try slightly increasing the intensity, adjusting the pad placement, or using a modulation mode (if available) to vary the stimulation pattern.

If this happens, you can try slightly increasing the intensity, adjusting the pad placement, or using a modulation mode (if available) to vary the stimulation pattern.

source.question: What settings should I use for my very first Ultima 5 session?
source.answer: Your Quick Start Guide recommends a simple starting point: set the frequency to 150Hz, the pulse width to 250us, and the mode to Constant. Turn the intensity up to a level that feels strong but comfortable, and use the unit for 30-45 minutes, or as long as needed. For your wave form, start with the Asymmetrical Bi-Phasic Rectangular setting, it's the recommended starting point for initial treatment. From there, feel free to adjust based on comfort and results.

source.question: Why is only one pad working?
source.answer: If only one pad seems to be producing a sensation, the issue is usually related to pad contact, connections, or the electrode itself. Try these steps: Check the pad connection: Make sure both lead wires are firmly connected to the TENS unit and electrode pads. Test the pads: Swap the pads or cables to see if the issue follows the pad or the channel. Replace the pad: A worn or dried-out electrode may not conduct properly. Improve the skin contact: Clean and dry the skin, then reapply the pads firmly. Check the channel settings: Make sure both channels are turned on if your unit has multiple channels.

tests.question: how can i know which pads are best for me pls

source.question: How do I know which pads are best for me?
source.answer: The best TENS pads depend on where you are treating, the size of the area, and your comfort preference. Consider: Small pads: Best for targeted areas like wrists, ankles, elbows, or smaller joints. Large pads: Best for larger areas like the lower back, shoulders, hips or thighs. Longer Lasting Pads: Better for frequent users who need more repeated sessions. Flexible Pads: Helpful for areas that move often, like knees, shoulders, or joints. For the best results, choose pads that provide good skin contact,comfortable stimulation, and proper coverage for your treatment area.

tests.question: why does the intensity suddenly decrease pls

source.question: Why does the intensity suddenly decrease?
source.answer: A sudden drop in intensity is usually caused by changes in pad contact, skin resistance, or the unit's built-in adjustments. Common causes include: Your body adapting to the stimulation: Nerve can become less sensitive to the sensation over time. Pads losting contact: Sweat, movement, or worn adhesive can reduce conductivity. Automatic modulation: Some TENS modes adjust the stimulation level or pattern to keep the sensation comfortable. Low battery: Reduced power can affect stimulation strength. Loose connections: Check that the lead wires and pads are securely attached.

source.question: How long do TENS pads last?
source.answer: TENS electrodes typically last 10-30 uses,depending on the quality of the pads, how often they are used, skin condition, and how well they are cared for. To help extend the lifespan of an electrode: Apply pads to clean, dry skin. Store them properly on the provided backing sheet. Avoid using lotions or oils before application. Replace pads when they lose stickiness or stimulation becomes uneven.

tests.question: Why does my skin turn red after treatment Also, can I use TENS with a pacemaker?

source.question: Why does my skin turn red after treatment?
source.answer: Mild redness after using a TENS unit can be normal and is often caused by increased circulation, pressure from the electrode, or mild skin sensitivity. It should typically fade shortly after removing the pads. To reduce skin irritation: Make sure your skin is clean and dry before use. Avoid placing pads on irritated or damaged skin. Rotate pad placement between treatments. Reduce treatment intensity if the sensation feels uncomfortable. Replace electrodes when the gel becomes old or irritating.
answerAlternatives:
Mild redness after using a TENS unit can be normal and is often caused by increased circulation, pressure from the electrode, or mild skin sensitivity. It should typically fade shortly after removing the pads. To reduce skin irritation: Make sure your skin is clean and dry before use. Avoid placing pads on irritated or damaged skin. Rotate pad placement between treatments. Reduce treatment intensity if the sensation feels uncomfortable. Replace electrodes when the gel becomes old or irritating.

Useful Resources & Links:
📋 [TENS Electrode Placement Chart](https://paintechnology.s3.amazonaws.com/pdf/placementchart.pdf)

payload.chatInput: Can you explain the PMT information about Cryotherapy and Hot Water Treatement System - Water Circulating Device by Aqua Relief with Universal Pad For P?

response.answer:
The Cryotherapy and Hot Water Treatment System by Aqua Relief is a **water-circulating hot/cold therapy unit**, not a traditional TENS (electrical stimulation) unit. It uses flowing water through pads/wraps to deliver temperature therapy for pain and post-surgical recovery.

Here is the key PMT information summarized for the versions with universal-style pads/wraps:

1. **How the system is used**
- The unit quietly circulates hot or cold water through a **leak-free 52" hose** to a therapy pad/wrap.
- This gives the treatment area **full coverage** with either heat or cold.
- You **add ice and water** for cold therapy, or use the built‑in heating function for warm therapy.

2. **Cold (Cryotherapy) function**
- When you add ice, the **cryo-cool system circulates cold water for up to about 5 hours**.
- Intended to help **reduce edema and swelling** using cold water.
- Used after surgery or injury as part of recovery in appropriate settings.

3. **Hot water / heat therapy function**
- The **heating system warms up in under 10 minutes**.
- You can set it to provide the **desired heat level**.
- **Low-level heat** can be used for **long-duration treatment** for individuals with chronic or acute disabilities, as directed.

4. **Universal wrap / pad options**
- A typical **universal wrap is about 11" x 11"** and comes with a **3" x 39" Velcro strap**, allowing it to be secured to many body areas:
  - Hip
  - Ankle
  - Wrist
  - Shoulder
  - Leg
  - Elbow
- There are versions/package options that come with different pads:
  - **Universal pad/wrap**
  - **Knee pad**
  - **Shoulder pad**
- **Additional pad designs** are sold separately.

5. **Indication for use**
- Listed for use in a **hospital setting** to help treat certain **chronic and acute disabilities**, including post‑surgical recovery and conditions needing sustained hot or cold therapy.

6. **Model / product codes (examples)**
- Aqua Relief water-circulating hot/cold systems are listed with codes such as:
  - **ARSwTPU** – with Universal Pad
  - **ARSwBACK** – with Back Pad
  - **ARSwKNEE** – with Knee Pad
  - **ARSwSHOULDER** – with Shoulder Pad

7. **Basic use & care notes**
- Always keep **water above the fill line** when operating.
- **Not for commercial/continuous use** – typical pump life expectancy is about **1700 hours**.
- Empty the unit appropriately after use (per product instructions).

8. **Compatibility & connectors (if you have other brand units)**
- PMT also offers a **Cold Water Therapy Coupling Converter** that allows some competitor cryotherapy units to connect to **PMT brand water therapy pads**. These converters:
  - Replace existing fittings to make them compatible with PMT pads.
  - Use **quick-connect/disconnect couplings** to help reduce leaks and make attachment easier.

If you tell me which body area you’re planning to use it on (knee, shoulder, back, etc.), I can focus the explanation more specifically on the best matching Aqua Relief pad option from PMT’s line.

payload.chatInput: Could you summarize PMT's information about Jaw Fit - Jaw Line Traction - Silicone chewable?

response.answer:
The Jawfit Jaw Line Traction silicone chewable is a portable facial and jaw exerciser designed to:

• **Target facial and jaw muscles** – Activates key muscles including the masticatory (chewing) muscles, tongue muscles, muscles around the mouth and eyes, soft palate/fauces, suprahyoid and infrahyoid muscles, strap and cervical area, and pharyngeal muscles.

• **Refine jawline & reduce double chin** – Intended to help minimize a double chin, define the jawline, tighten facial muscles, and make the skin appear firmer when used regularly as an exercise tool.

• **Support mouth-breathers & oral function** – Aims to strengthen oral musculature to help reduce mouth-only breathing and improve dry mouth, and may assist with certain mouth and facial problems such as halitosis, stomatitis, acne/pimples, and facial symmetry.

• **Assist with chewing-related issues** – Marketed as potentially helpful for difficulty swallowing and/or slobbering, and may be used to help reduce cravings by engaging the jaw in chewing activity.

• **Exercise concept** – It is specifically described as an **exerciser** and should be used like a workout: you repeatedly make a “kissing motion”/chewing motion with it in your mouth to train and strengthen the jaw and facial muscles.

• **Construction & materials** –
  - Made from medical-/food-grade BPA-free silicone
  - Tear-resistant with improved elasticity and higher tensile strength (2nd-generation design)
  - Designed to protect teeth, gums, and joints compared with some other jaw training models

• **Use & routine** – For the 2nd-generation Jawline Facial Exerciser, PMT notes that about **10 minutes of daily chewing** can be used as a typical routine to help sculpt the jawline and strengthen facial appearance.

• **Portability & discretion** – Highly portable; includes a carrying case and is designed so the silicone tablets can be hidden in the mouth, allowing you to exercise in public settings.

• **Product codes & variants** –
  - Jaw Traction Device / Jawfit (plastic exerciser): PRODUCT CODE JF100
  - Jawfit Jaw Line Traction – Silicone Chewable (black): PRODUCT CODE JF1002B
  - Jawfit Jaw Line Traction – Silicone Chewable (white): PRODUCT CODE JF1002W

Note: Jawfit is an exercise and cosmetic-support device targeting facial and jaw muscles. For any medical conditions (jaw pain, TMJ disorders, difficulty swallowing, etc.), you should consult a healthcare professional before use.

 Neck Travel Pillow by Skypillow, One-of-a-kind Orthopedic Travel Pillow, Prevent Neck Cramps, Improve Posture; Memory Foam and Adjustable, Washable Cover, Includes Carrying Case and Clip (Blue) (SM)

 A BETTER NECK PILLOW: Many travel pillows aren't firm enough to properly support the neck and end up caving in to even the slightest amount of pressure. This does very little to actually help relieve neck pain or provide comfort during travel. The SkyPillow corrects this with sturdy memory foam construction that cradles the neck that reduces strain and keeps the head in an upright position.

The average height of the neck is around 10-13 centimeters but generic pillows are typically only 6-8cm high, providing very little support for the neck. This breathable and lightweight fabric makes for a super comfortable pillow as the flow of air prevents the user from feeling overly constricted. During long periods of sitting or travel, it can be difficult to have something wrapped around your neck when the heat and sweat build. Keep your neck cool and comfy with the SkyPillow!

Treating the pain is one thing, but it doesn’t address the root of the problem. Correcting your posture is crucial to prevent the condition of the neck and shoulders from recurring or worsening. The Skypillow is meant to cradle the head, forcing it to remain in an upright and proper position which slowly corrects posture and prevents the buildup of further tension and pain.

For additional convenience, the Skypillow is able to be folded into a third of its normal size and comes with a convenient carrying case for ease of packing. payload.chatInput: Could you summarize PMT's information about Neck Travel Pillow by Skypillow, Comfortable and Breathable Memory Foam Neck Pillow with Adjustable Straps, Re?

response.answer:
The Neck Travel Pillow by SkyPillow is designed as a firmer, orthopedic-style travel pillow to better support the neck and help prevent neck cramps and strain during travel.

Key points from PMT’s information:

- **Improved Support vs. Typical Travel Pillows**: Many standard neck pillows are too soft and collapse under pressure, offering little real support. SkyPillow uses **sturdy memory foam** that cradles the neck, helping keep the head in an upright position to reduce strain.

- **Ergonomic Height & Sizing**:
  - Typical generic travel pillows are about **6–8 cm** high, which is often too low for adults (average neck height is about 10–13 cm).
  - SkyPillow is designed with a **height of 12 cm** to better match adult neck height.
  - It comes in **two sizes** (for the standard models) with **adjustable straps** so you can tighten/loosen for a secure, personalized fit:
    - **Small**: Fits neck circumference **12.5" – 14.5"**
    - **Large**: Fits neck circumference **14.5" – 16.5"**

- **Comfortable & Breathable Fabric**: The pillow is covered with **CoolPass, an ultra-breathable fabric** that allows air to pass through. This lightweight, ventilated design is meant to keep the neck cooler and reduce the hot, sweaty feeling that can come from having fabric wrapped around your neck for long periods.

- **Posture-Oriented Design**: The combination of **memory foam support, correct height, and adjustable strap** is intended to help keep the neck aligned and the head upright, which can support better posture during sitting or travel.

- **Travel-Friendly & Washable** (from the broader SkyPillow line): SkyPillow models include a **removable, washable cover** for easier cleaning and come with a **carrying case**; the pillow can be folded down significantly for packing and can clip to bags or luggage.

If you’d like, I can also summarize the differences between the Small, Large, and Hoodie versions of the SkyPillow.

   - Because these devices **apply traction to your cervical spine**, you should **consult your healthcare provider** before using them, especially if you have neck injuries, prior surgery, osteoporosis, disc disease, or any other spinal condition.

response.answer:
Sleep Cream by PMT is a natural, topical sleeping aid designed to help regulate sleep patterns and make it easier to fall asleep, using only ingredients found in nature.

Key points from PMT about Sleep Cream:

- **Purpose & Effect**: It is a relaxing, all‑natural, calming cream that helps the body relax **without directly inducing sleep**. By easing a busy mind and calming the body, it helps falling asleep come more naturally and supports healthier day‑to‑day circadian rhythm.

- **How it works**:
  - **Lavender & Citrus Fruit Extract**: The scent of lavender is used for its naturally calming properties. It has been shown to help the body relax and can support improved overall sleep quality. Lavender is commonly used in aromatherapy for this purpose.
  - **Menthol**: Provides a cool, soothing sensation on the skin as you drift off to sleep.

- **Use & Application**:
  - Safe to use **anywhere on the body**.
  - Many people apply it to the **neck, face, chest, or arms** so they can easily smell the relaxing lavender aroma while the menthol cools and soothes.
  - The 2.83 oz size is designed to be **portable for travel**, so you can maintain your sleep routine wherever you stay.

- **Safety & Formula**:
  - **All‑natural formula** using only ingredients found in nature.
  - **No artificial ingredients, synthetic chemicals, fragrances, GMOs, or other potentially harmful additives**.
  - PMT notes that, because it is free of artificial ingredients, it is **safe for daily use** without known side effects or increasing tolerance.
  - Described as **safe and effective** for topical use as directed.

- **Product Notes**:
  - Category: Therapeutic Creams and Gels.
  - Typical size: 2.83 oz (also referenced in a 4 oz description under the same product line).

For purchasing details, current sizes, or full ingredient listing, you can visit PMT’s main catalog at https://paintechnology.com/category or search for “Sleep Cream by PMT, Natural Sleeping Aid” on the site.

source.question: Will my body get used to TENS?
source.answer: Yes, your body can adapt to TENS stimulation over time, which may make the sensation feel less noticeable. This a normal response called habituation. response.answer:
A Transcutaneous Electrical Nerve Stimulation (TENS) unit helps relieve pain by sending gentle electrical pulses through electrode pads placed on the skin. These pulses stimulate the nerves, which can help block pain signals before they reach the brain and may also encourage the release of endorphins—your body’s natural pain relievers.

TENS is designed to manage pain, not cure or heal the underlying cause. Pain relief and how long it lasts can vary from person to person. Some people only feel relief while the unit is on, while others may continue to feel relief for a period of time after it is turned off.

Over time, if you feel your usual settings are helping less, this doesn’t necessarily mean your body is permanently “used to” TENS, but some users do need to adjust how they use it (for example, changing modes, pad placement, or session timing) under the guidance of their prescribing healthcare professional.

TENS is a drug-free option for managing pain such as back pain, arthritis, sciatica, muscle soreness, and joint pain, and it may help you stay more active and comfortable in daily activities. Always use your TENS unit according to your physician’s directions.

 IN-HOME HAIR LOSS TREATMENT - Offering discrete, comfortable use our laser for hair growth cap promotes rapid hair growth with evenly-distributed diodes that are safe, effective, and support men and women looking to restore hair and confidence.

 REAL, CONSISTENT, MEASURABLE RESULTS - Studies show the Laser Hero cap for hair regrowth can provide a statistical advantage for those seeking to reduce hair loss and strengthen growth with results seen in as little as 12-24 weeks with consistent use.

 THERAPY INFO

 WARRANTY

The hands-free design is easy to use, small in size, and lightweight, making it ideal for home use. The Laser Hero is comfortable, secure, and effective for all hair types.

Laser Hero Hair Regrowth Therapy Helmet – Standard is an advanced, FDA-cleared medical device designed to help combat hair loss and promote hair regrowth in both men and women.

Key information PMT provides about the Laser Hero Standard:

- **Therapy Type**: Uses low-level laser therapy (LLLT) with low-energy soft laser irradiation and red light diodes.
- **Intended Use**: Helps stimulate hair growth at the follicle level to treat:
  - General hair loss
  - Alopecia areata
  - Seborrheic alopecia
  - Thinning or receding hair in men and women
- **Benefits (as described by PMT)**:
  - Supports restoration of thicker, healthier hair
  - Can improve hair thickness, volume, manageability, strength, and pigment
  - Non-invasive, painless, and comfortable for home use
- **Treatment Routine**:
  - Designed for in-home use multiple times per week
  - Recommended in 30‑minute intervals per session
  - Results have been reported in studies as possible in approximately **12–24 weeks** with consistent use
- **Design & Features**:
  - Helmet/cap style hair regrowth system
  - Evenly distributed laser diodes for uniform scalp coverage
  - Hands‑free, small, and lightweight design
  - Comfortable and secure fit for all hair types
  - **Wireless** operation after charging (full charge in about 6 hours)
  - Can be used while doing normal activities (e.g., watching TV, sitting in bed, working at a desk, or doing light tasks around the house)
- **Product Codes / Variants**:
  - Laser Hero Hair Regrowth Therapy Helmet – Standard: product code **LH100** (Standard model)
  - A related Laser Hero model is also listed under product code **LTH200G** (Premium Green color), described with similar technology and benefits.
- **General Description**:
  - Described as an advanced, FDA‑cleared system for battling hair loss and preventing receding, thinning hair using clinically proven low-level laser therapy.
  - Delivers low‑level power and light energy to the scalp to energize follicles and promote natural hair growth, focusing on improved thickness, fullness, and pigment.

For more details, specifications, or purchasing options, you can view PMT’s product catalog at: https://paintechnology.com/category
